Authenticated demo session and browser mutation boundary. Authenticated user session required for all writes; CSRF/origin/rate-limit tests; backend token never returned to browser; direct unauthorized requests fail.

## API Contract
Preserve current domain routes and error envelope; add reviewed session routes, cookie/CSRF contract and explicit actor dependency

Canonical examples: `contracts/financial-state.example.json`, `contracts/action-request.example.json`, `contracts/requests.example.json`. These are shape fixtures, never evidence of live chain configuration or successful verification. Error envelope: `{"code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED","message":"Feature awaiting implementation","reasons":[]}`. Amounts ending `_minor` are integer USD cents; token base units are decimal strings; probabilities are integer basis points.

## Definition of Done
Reviewed issue-linked PR merged with passing CI and integration evidence; dependent issue statuses updated. A code stub or fixture does not complete a feature.

## Out of scope
New scenarios, mainnet/real money, production custody, duplicate schemas, unrelated rewrites, or changes to approved architecture.

## Implementation evidence

PR https://github.com/akiibot/proofFi/pull/37 (contract-change; refreshed from `main` after #36 merged). HTTP API v1.1 adds actual cookie sessions and origin/CSRF requirements. The old bearer identity path is rejected. Financial/state/certificate/transaction schemas unchanged; no migration.

Current full local validation passed: 95 backend tests, 4 real browser/API tests, lint/typecheck/build and generated contracts; migration check found no new operations. The focused PF-033 suite passed 18 tests and a three-repeat browser stress run passed 12/12 after fixing successful logins consuming the failed-login budget. The historical integrated-stack redirect timeout remains separately documented. Real local credentials were previously scanned against staged files and browser bundles without printing them; no matches. See docs/AUTHENTICATION.md and docs/TEST_RESULTS.md. Sessions use one API process; public-mode settings require HTTPS/Secure cookies. No policy activation, financial approval or execution is implied.
